limitations: This is a bounded local/synthetic production-build browser receipt, not a complete role-by-route, state, interaction, or environment matrix execution.
The CDP visual-scale probes do not certify every native-browser zoom implementation.

The notification visual-scale probe used normal keyboard tab activation rather than pointer coordinates because visual scale invalidates Playwright pointer hit-testing; the same scoped text and containment assertions passed.
This is a redacted aggregation of independently source-bound reports, not a new browser run, and it does not alter those reports or create final acceptance authority.
No raw screenshot, trace, console log, network log, local path, local URL, fixture payload, or user data is retained in this repository receipt.

claimBoundary: This bounded source-bound local/synthetic long-text wrapping receipt does not alter prior historical receipts, protected-surface freeze, full Stage 8 acceptance, owner aesthetic sign-off, a visual freeze, merge authority, Figma authority, Sites authority, staging authority, or production authority.
retention: Only redacted counts, source revisions, source hashes, dist/report hashes, validation totals, and claim boundaries are retained.
